name: Sous Chef
description: Pulls well-reviewed recipes into a week's meal plan, turns that into a shopping list, and will place the order if asked. Suited to people cooking at home who mainly want the decision made before they get to the kitchen.

official.title: Sous Chef by Amber
official.description: Finds highly rated recipes, builds meal plans and grocery lists, and shops when you want. For home cooks who want dinner figured out.
